d: A recurring pattern of internal pressure and public pushback has drawn scrutiny in Karnataka politics, highlighted by Mudigere MLA Nayana Motamma's resignation move over elephant movement concerns near the Bhadra forest landscape and Indi MLA Yashwantharayagouda Patil's earlier resignation threat over drought-hit taluk exclusions. Alongside constituency demands, disputes over Cabinet berths and portfolio control—involving leaders such as Tanveer Sait, Ramalinga Reddy, Krishna Byre Gowda, and H.C. Mahadevappa—as well as community sensitivities around Ravi Hanj's book Basava Mantapa and M.B.…
